title: Backend Service Contract Hardening
summary: Harden Backend service readiness into explicit contracts and route-visible status so frontend redesign work cannot mistake local development readiness for production Backend readiness.
expectedOutput: Backend-owned contract and tests that expose unresolved production readiness requirements as explicit blocking capabilities or deployment preflight facts, followed by a Project Control evidence record after Backend verification.
riskSummary: Until Backend implementation and verification are complete, production readiness remains blocked for auth, tenancy, storage provider selection, worker orchestration, export route mounting, renderer/provider binding, deployment, TLS/proxy, rate limits, telemetry, backup, and rollback. This Work record is an execution target, not evidence.
